_about: Video setup guides on the website (site/guides/<slug>/). Each video is site/media/guide-<slug>.webm (dashboard, 1280x800) or .mp4 (phone, 1080x2400 screen recording), with a poster guide-<slug>.webp. source says how it is recorded: mock = tests/dashboard-mock with demo data (tools/marketing/capture-guides.mjs), emulator = a real Homedroid on the Android emulator, existing = already recorded. doc is the written guide it accompanies, if any.

guides.title: Set up Homedroid on an old phone
guides.summary: Install the APK, start the server, and open the dashboard from your computer.

guides.title: Install apps and choose where their data lives
guides.summary: Install Jellyfin or any app from the library, see what it needs in memory and CPU, and move its library to an SD card or USB drive.

guides.title: Reach your server from anywhere
guides.summary: Private access with Tailscale, or publish a site to the internet with a Cloudflare Tunnel, without opening ports on your router.

guides.title: Automate movies and TV with Radarr, Sonarr and Jellyseerr
guides.summary: Install the media apps, request a movie in Jellyseerr, and watch it reach Radarr, qBittorrent and Jellyfin.

guides.title: Use the phone as a NAS
guides.summary: Browse, upload, download and share files in the browser, and reach them over SFTP.

guides.title: Customize the dashboard: layouts, themes and fonts
guides.summary: Try all six layouts and 13 themes, change the fonts, or start from a preset. Saved on the phone, so it follows you to every browser.

guides.title: Install other Linux software with apk
guides.summary: Open the terminal, choose Alpine Linux and install packages such as git, Python or ffmpeg.

guides.title: Deploy a website or app from GitHub
guides.summary: Point a deployment at a repository, watch the build pipeline, and redeploy on every push with a deploy hook.

guides.title: Use your own domain
guides.summary: Add a domain and prove you own it, keep dynamic DNS up to date, and limit who can reach your sites with the firewall.

guides.title: Run your own mail server
guides.summary: Install Stalwart, follow the setup, copy the DNS records it shows, and add mailboxes.

guides.title: Run a local AI model on the phone
guides.summary: Download a model, chat with it, and use the OpenAI-compatible API from your other apps.

guides.title: Let Claude, Cursor or VS Code manage the server
guides.summary: Turn on the MCP server, copy the connection settings, and decide which tools assistants may use.

guides.title: Pair Homedroid Desktop: MacroPads and the phone webcam
guides.summary: Pair your computer with a six-digit code, build a button deck, and use the phone as a webcam.

guides.title: Share the phone's internet with a Wi-Fi repeater
guides.summary: Start the repeater network, then join it from a laptop or phone with the QR code and proxy settings.

guides.title: Block ads on every device with AdGuard Home
guides.summary: Install AdGuard Home, sign in, and point your devices or tailnet at the phone for DNS.
